target: Deployed finite Cherchi intersection/difference with level 2 and GROW_TO_CERTIFIED_V1; use the actual moving operand and its cap faces
units: registered target coordinates and density; undoubled cross moments
volume_rule: Use a static positive material measure that reproduces all mesh moments through degree two. Fixed physical material is added once, separately.
checks: raw coefficient or typed stratum motion and rejection

screening_limits.scales: editable mesh mass times bounding-box longest material extent raised to monomial degree; unit raw coefficients and normalized tangent directions. Compare raw unscaled errors as well.
screening_limits.purpose: proposed screening limits, to validate with native training-side sensitivity before learned candidates; diagnostics with unknown ambient event do not certify a derivative

deterministic_primary.interpretation: bandwidth is the compact transition half-width in target coordinates; diagnostic block pruning preserves the same quadrature rule

pilot.primary: source-macro Moment RMSE reduction >=5% vs same arm epoch 0, earliest minimum among epochs 1-3
pilot.protections: Full-J, R3, R8 and middle/high retained mass errors each <=1.05 times their epoch 0 values. Report differences from both previous epoch and epoch 0.
pilot.admission: all arms require matching deploy-teacher overlay, exact published train/development geometry/query coverage, separate eligibility masks and positive certified development R8 support, actual joint update and checkpoint restoration

solver.diagnostic: Noodles v8; seed 0 trajectory for development
solver.choice: first eligible external-case record in frozen publisher order; only metadata opened at registration
solver.acceptance: same native initialization, constraints, tolerances and policy; independent mesh constraints, positive multiplier, convergence and paired objective within 1% of native; include all failures and fallbacks
solver.timing: end-to-end time through fresh independent verification, cold and warm separately; setup, surface motion, transfers, inference, line search, fallback and failures charged; paired 95% CI upper time-ratio bound <1
